name: Fast (one-click checkout)
title: Was Fast too early? No: the slot was already taken
question: Was Fast's one-click checkout too early?
answer: Fast raised over $120M for one-click checkout and shut down in April 2022; its 2021 revenue was reported at about $600,000. One-click buying already existed at scale through Amazon and Shopify's Shop Pay. Nothing was missing from the market; Fast was missing distribution.
verdict_reason: Shop Pay and Amazon already offered one-click checkout at scale.

constraint.name: Nothing was missing
constraint.detail: The enablers it needed already existed; something else killed it.

graveyard.name: Fast
graveyard.how: Shut down in April 2022 after raising over $120M; reported 2021 revenue was about $600K
